articles.summary: Today, November 6, 2026, Emera Inc. (“Emera”) (TSX/NYSE: EMA) reported 2026 third quarter financial results and 5-year capital and funding plans 1 . Third Quarter Five-Year Capital Plan Highlights Reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS 2 of $0.85 and reported EPS of $0.59. Introduced five-year, $21.5 billion capital plan 3 , expected to drive 7.5%-8.5% rate base growth through 2031 4 , with ~82% of planned investment in Florida 5 to support customer demand. Increased dividend for the 20 th consecutive year, reflecting continued confidence in the strength and durability of the business, and supported by solid execution and disciplined capital allocation. Safely advanced approximately $2.8B of customer-focused infrastructure investment year to date and remain on track to execute $4B annual capital plan in 2026. Positioned to deliver 2026 adjusted EPS 2 growth above the annual target range of 5-7% 6 while maintaining 5-7% adjusted EPS 2 growth target through 2030. Strengthened year-to-date
articles.title: Emera Reports 2026 Third Quarter Financial Results and Unveils $21.5 Billion Five-Year Capital Plan
